title: Closing and Funding Prepaid Per Diem Interest Policy
content:
## Clauses in force

1. Interest on a Closing and Funding loan accrues from the disbursement date.
2. At closing, prepaid interest is collected from the estimated funding date through the last day of that month, both days counted.
3. The amount of a prepaid interest entry is its daily interest amount times its interest days.
4. When the actual disbursement date is later than the estimated funding date, the refund for funding later than estimated is made at the same daily amount, within the method's per diem refund business days.
5. When funding is earlier than estimated, the shortfall is never billed after closing (the method's term on billing an early-funding shortfall after closing is No).
6. An arithmetic mistake is refunded as a calculation error.
7. A prepaid interest refund corrects only a charge entry that has not already been refunded for the same reason. Each refund names the charge entry it corrects.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses of this policy are **no longer in force** and have been superseded by the current prepaid interest basis; they are kept here so that the earlier wording is recognisable:

- "The daily interest amount is the loan amount times the note rate percent divided by the per diem day-count basis, rounded to the per diem daily rounding decimals" — no longer in force.
- "The interest for the days from the estimated funding date up to the day before the disbursement date is refunded as a refund for funding later than estimated" — no longer in force.
- "When disbursement moves into the next month, every day collected for the earlier month is refunded" — no longer in force.
- "Interest for days lost to a wire returned for a Larkspur-side reason is refunded as a returned-wire delay refund where Larkspur bears returned-wire interest" — no longer in force.

The per diem day-count basis and rounding figures themselves remain valid terms of every closing method.

## Duplicate-refund check

| Charge entry already carries a refund for... | New refund for the same reason? | New refund for a different reason? |
|---|---|---|
| no reason (never refunded) | Allowed | Allowed |
| the same reason | Not allowed | Allowed |

The check reads the system record of refunds that name the same charge entry and their reasons.

## Worked example of clauses 2 and 3 (hypothetical figures)

A charge collected at closing for an estimated funding date of the 26th of a 30-day month covers the 26th through the 30th, both counted: 5 interest days. At a daily interest amount of 41.10, the entry amount is 41.10 times 5, which is 205.50.

superseded_clauses: daily_interest_amount is loan_amount times note_rate percent divided by per_diem_day_count_basis, rounded to per_diem_daily_rounding_decimals
the interest for the days from estimated_funding_date up to the day before disbursement_date is refunded (funding_later_than_estimated)
when disbursement moves into the next month, every day collected for the earlier month is refunded
Interest for days lost to a wire returned for a Larkspur-side reason is refunded (returned_wire_delay) where returned_wire_interest_borne_by_larkspur is true.
